The table below is `docs/FEATURES.md` from the repository, unchanged. The status
column is the one the maintainers keep: **verified** means compared against R
tidymodels output in the differential suite (or against an analytic baseline),
**unit-tested** means fixed by unit or property tests only, **unsupported** means not
in this release. The semantic detail behind every row is in the repository's
`COMPATIBILITY.md`; the known gaps are on the [Gaps](gaps.qmd) page.
